description: This file contains SCSS mixins for styling form controls, specifically for managing focus states and validation states, including feedback messages and icons. It is part of the style definitions for a frontend UI framework, likely Bootstrap, and provides reusable style blocks for form elements.
external_files: possibly a color-yiq() function for contrast calculation

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Mixin that applies focus styles to form controls, including color, background, border, outline, and box-shadow when elements are focused, with optional box-shadow based on a variable.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: Mixin to style validation feedback and tooltips for different input states, including border color, background, icons, and visibility, for various validation states (e.g., success, error).
